hotel_name: Golden Suites Gurgaon | Inde Hotels & Resorts

negative_snippets:
Housekeeping standards at the property are disappointing. The TV in my room was non-functional due to charging issues. In my friend’s room, the bathroom door could not be locked from inside, and despite complaints, no one came to repair it. The shower in my bathroom was choked and not usable. Food quality was below expectations; bread and idli served at breakfast were not fresh. Basic amenities like bath towels and the doormat outside the washroom were missing and only provided after repeated reminders.
While the property itself has potential, it suffers from poor maintenance. There are two lifts, but both are very slow and one malfunctioned, causing a guest to be stuck inside for 15 minutes.
I hope management addresses these shortcomings promptly to protect the reputation of what could otherwise be a good place to stay.

Guest

For the safety of you and your loved ones, do not choose this hotel. I went their for the wedding and entire experience was pathetic !! Let me share some of the incidents -
1. There was a delay in room allocation to bride/groom relatives due to incompetent management. The events were taking place back to back but guests were struggling because majority of them had not received any room key yet.
2. In the evening, when room allocation wasn't completed, the management had a fight with groom. The family then called police for complaint and support. Eventually, the higher management woke up and tried to hide their mistake.
3. The manager was ill-mannered, irresponsible and was fighting with event management team, photographers as well. They even stopped, questioned the team while having lunch. Even when family had allowed them.
4. There so called executive room was not properly clean enough, bathroom door was jammed, shower and washroom jet were not working properly. If we called house keeping for help, they took their sweet time to visit and help. If asked, their polite response sir "The team is aware, they will visit in sometime".
6. Some of the staff members even abused the event management members without any reason. They were messing with them and bad-mouthing.

In conclusion, only good look/view does not gaurantee a great experience. It's the people who make the place heavan or hell.

🚨🚫 ONE OF THE WORST WEDDING VENUES EVER 🚫🚨
Review for Golden Tulip Hotel

This hotel is a COMPLETE NIGHTMARE 😡💸 Choosing this place for our sister’s wedding was one of the biggest mistakes we have ever made.

We hosted the Haldi, Ring Ceremony, and wedding related events here and booked around 60 rooms for two nights. The experience was horrible for us and every single guest 🤦‍♂️

The service is beyond pathetic. Check in took forever ⏳ Staff is untrained, unprofessional, and does not care at all. Even reception staff privately admitted that the hotel is badly managed 😐

Rooms and washrooms smelled awful 🤢 Hygiene standards are extremely poor. Washrooms were frequently clogged and dirty 🚽❌

🚨 Major safety issues that the hotel completely ignored 🚨
• Lifts got stuck at least 10 times, with guests including small children trapped for nearly 30 minutes 😡🚸
• In one room, the door railing in Room 701 fell on a guest, which could have caused serious injury 🚪⚠️
• Lawn area had potholes and uneven surfaces, and guests kept tripping and falling 🌿💥

Food and hospitality were equally terrible 🍽️❌
• Food was served cold and badly managed
• Breakfast buffet was awful and not worth the money at all 👎
• Room lockers did not work and took almost 6 hours to fix 🔐⏳
• Pot lights in rooms were broken and did not work 💡❌
• Towels were extremely dirty and we had to beg for replacements 🧺🤢

The event management was a disaster 🎉🔥
• Hotel staff and decorators were constantly arguing instead of working together
• This delayed our event by 2 hours, causing stress and embarrassment
• One hotel staff member became aggressive and got into verbal abuse and a physical fight with our event planner 😡👊

We were promised a hall at 9:00 AM, and even at 9:00 the hall was locked 🔒 Nobody cared, nobody responded, nobody apologized.

Even the Duty Manager, Mr. Anurag, was completely unsupportive and dismissive when issues were escalated 😠

This hotel does NOT care about
• Guest safety 🚫
• Weddings or events 🚫
• Your time 🚫
• Your money 🚫

Overall, this place shows a complete lack of professionalism, safety, hygiene, and basic hospitality standards.

⚠️ STRONG WARNING ⚠️
Please avoid this hotel at all costs, especially for weddings or important events. This place is a waste of money and an emotional nightmare. 👎👎👎
